displayDescription: Wax-crayon miniature tabletop: an idea sphere connects to a system cylinder while a house slides in by parallax.
audioDescription: Silent preview: no music, sound effects or narration.
limitations: Wax crayon is approximated with seeded procedural Canvas 2D stroke textures plus a bump map on Three.js standard materials; it is not a scanned or physically simulated crayon medium.
Contact shadows combine a soft shadow map with time-keyed gradient blobs; no ambient occlusion or depth-of-field blur.
No Blender was used, per the user's instruction; the scene is built entirely in Three.js.
STYLE.json supplies no preview_recipes and no BACKGROUND_REVIEW.json exists, so the preview demonstrates the catalogue characteristic action rather than a reviewed recipe.
